text: BM25 sparse retrieval uses term frequency for ranking.
Dense retrieval uses neural embeddings for semantic search.
Hybrid retrieval combines sparse and dense scores with fusion.
Cross-encoder rerankers improve precision at the top of the list.
Recall at K measures how many relevant documents appear in the top K.
NDCG rewards ranking relevant documents near the top.
Multi-stage pipelines chain a retriever with one or more rerankers.
Latency budgets trade retrieval quality against response time.
